GOT QUESTIONS?

Frequently asked questions.

Find answers to common questions about our mattress and foam product range. If you need more information, feel free to contact our team.

Ask Us a Question ↗
01 What types of mattresses are available at SS Traders? +
Our product range includes orthopedic, foam, rebonded or bonded, spring and memory foam mattresses. Contact us to enquire about available options.
02 Do you offer orthopedic mattresses? +
Yes, orthopedic mattresses are included in our product range. You can contact our team to discuss your comfort and support requirements.
03 What is the difference between foam and spring mattresses? +
Foam mattresses use foam materials for cushioning, while spring mattresses use a spring-based support system. The right choice depends on your preferred comfort and sleeping needs.
04 Do you provide PU foam and HR foam? +
Yes, PU foam and HR foam are among the foam product categories offered by SS Traders Mattress. Contact us for product-related details.
05 How do I choose the right mattress? +
Consider your preferred firmness, sleeping position, comfort requirements and budget. Our team can help you explore different mattress categories.
06 Where is SS Traders Mattress located? +
SS Traders Mattress is based in Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh. Visit our Contact page for location details and directions.
07 How can I enquire about product prices? +
You can call or WhatsApp our team directly, or use the enquiry form on our Contact page.
08 How can I contact SS Traders Mattress? +
You can reach us through the phone and WhatsApp details provided on our website or send an enquiry through our Contact page.
